criteria.bill: A printed bill, receipt, invoice or weighment slip.
criteria.geotagged_photo: A photo with a GPS stamp printed on it: a place name or address, latitude and longitude, and a date and time, as added by a GPS map camera app.
criteria.other: Any other photo or document, including a photo with no GPS stamp.

orientation.instructions: Which way is the printed text in `image` turned?

criteria.upright: The text reads normally, left to right.
criteria.top_points_right: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the right edge.
criteria.top_points_left: The image is turned so the tops of the letters face the left edge.

in_hour.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what hour is its time in (the first, earlier time printed)? Give the hour on a 24-hour clock: 2:15 AM is 02, 2:15 PM is 14, 12:30 AM is 00.

criteria.not_shown: No time in is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.

in_minute.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what minute is its time in (the first, earlier time printed)?

criteria.not_shown: No time in is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.

out_hour.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what hour is its time out (the second, later time printed)? Give the hour on a 24-hour clock: 2:15 AM is 02, 2:15 PM is 14, 12:30 AM is 00.

criteria.not_shown: No second, later time is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.

out_minute.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what minute is its time out (the second, later time printed)?

criteria.not_shown: No second, later time is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.

bill_day.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what day of the month is the date printed on it?

criteria.not_shown: No date is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.

bill_month.instructions: If `image` is a bill, what month (01 to 12) is the date printed on it?

criteria.not_shown: No date is printed on a bill, or it can't be read.
